title: epidat – Datenbank zur jüdischen Grabsteinepigraphik
institution: Salomon Ludwig Steinheim-Institut für deutsch-jüdische Geschichte (Essen), with the Akademie der Wissenschaften und der Literatur | Mainz
license_note: Each EpiDoc record states CC BY 4.0; the site footer states CC BY 4.0 as well.
notes: Jewish gravestone inscriptions (322 digital editions, 54,243 monuments on the site; monuments after 1956 withheld). EpiDoc TEI per monument (?id=<code>-teip5) and bulk in the public GitLab repository (xml/tei, tsv, json, ttl). texts and words are our own count from tsv/id-year-transcription-translation.tsv (44,300 rows): rows with a parseable year 1450-1700 = 1,926; words = whitespace tokens of the transcription column for those rows (Hebrew transcription, often with a Latin-script rendering; approximate). 2,244 rows have no parseable year and are not counted; the vast majority of the corpus is 18th-20th century (about 82 rows 1450-1499, 72 rows 1500-1549), so the in-period share is about 4 percent, concentrated in Frankfurt (ffb 864), Hamburg-Altona (hha 270) and Worms (wrm 251). The older site interface is no longer developed; a beta interface exists. Repository last activity 2026-08-13.
